Specify per-column clipping constraints for bootstrap perturbation

Source: R/constraints.R
lb_constraints.Rd

Each named argument is a length-2 numeric vector c(lower, upper) giving the allowable range for that column after uncertainty injection. A column not listed receives an inferred default at lb_spec() time: c(0, Inf) if all observed values are >= 0, otherwise c(-Inf, Inf).

Usage

lb_constraints(...)

Arguments

...

Named arguments of the form column = c(lower, upper). Use c(0, Inf) for non-negative, c(0, 100) for weight percent, c(-Inf, Inf) to disable clipping for signed quantities.

Value

An lb_constraints object (a named list of numeric length-2 vectors).

Examples

lb_constraints(
  alumina  = c(0, 100),    # bounded weight percent
  SSA      = c(0, Inf),    # non-negative
  moisture = c(-Inf, Inf)  # signed, no clipping
)
#> $alumina
#> [1]   0 100
#> 
#> $SSA
#> [1]   0 Inf
#> 
#> $moisture
#> [1] -Inf  Inf
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "lb_constraints"
